story.title: Surveillance Video Released of Deadly Shooting at Idaho In-N-Out Burger
story.summary: Police have released surveillance footage from a mass shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho, which occurred last weekend. The video shows the gunman approaching the drive-thru window multiple times and opening fire, resulting in three fatalities and seven injuries. The incident has been described as chaotic, with bystanders attempting to assist the victims.

event_overview.title: About Investigation Underway Following Deadly Shooting at Idaho In-N-Out Burger
event_overview.subject: Investigation Underway Following Deadly Shooting at Idaho In-N-Out Burger
event_overview.summary: A mass shooting occurred on August 1, 2026, at an In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho, killing three people and injuring seven others. Twin Falls police identified the suspected shooter as 24-year-old Chad Williams and said he died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound; as of August 7, investigators were still working to establish a motive and had released surveillance video of the attack.

facts.label: Date and location
facts.value: The shooting took place on Saturday, August 1, 2026, at the In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, in southern Idaho.

facts.label: Casualties
facts.value: Three people were killed and seven others were injured; police said 10 people in total were shot across the restaurant area and nearby locations.

facts.label: Suspect and investigation
facts.value: Police identified the suspected shooter as Chad Williams, 24, and said he died by a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Investigators said they were confident he acted alone, while the motive remained under investigation.

facts.label: Lead agency
facts.value: The Twin Falls Police Department is the local law-enforcement agency leading public information on the case; its chief is Matthew Hicks.

facts.label: Video release
facts.value: On August 7, police released surveillance video and described the footage as part of their public account of the shooting and response.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline follows the August 4 investigation update and the August 7 surveillance-video release, rather than providing a complete account of every victim update, investigative step, or subsequent legal development.

related_stories.title: Teenager Commits Deadly Shooting at School After Killing Grandparents in Thailand
related_stories.summary: A 14-year-old boy in Thailand killed his grandparents before opening fire at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, resulting in at least eight deaths, including his own. The attack, which occurred just outside Bangkok, left more than 30 others injured. Authorities reported that the boy used a firearm belonging to his grandfather and fired a total of 26 rounds during the incident. The motive for the shooting remains unclear.

related_stories.title: Masseur Describes Maradona's Condition Before Death Amid Ongoing Negligence Trial
related_stories.summary: A masseur has described Diego Maradona as bloated, bedridden, and resigned in the days leading up to his death in 2020. This testimony comes as seven healthcare professionals are on trial in Argentina, facing allegations of negligence that may have contributed to the football legend's passing.
